nodes.description: Biallelic loss-of-function variants in the coding region of LCT prevent normal biosynthesis, folding, intracellular trafficking, or catalytic function of lactase-phlorizin hydrolase (LPH), the brush-border enzyme that hydrolyzes lactose. Several characterized CLD variants (e.g. p.Y1390*, p.E1612*, p.S1150Pfs*19, p.S1121L, p.R1587H, p.S688P) produce LPH proteins that are transport-incompetent and enzymatically inactive, so essentially no functional enzyme reaches the apical enterocyte membrane.
